headline: European Supermarkets Suffer Suspected Cooling System Cyberattack
summary: Supermarket chains across seven European countries reported overnight temperature spikes in fridges and freezers of up to 50C following a fresh suspected cyberattack.
why: Cyberattacks targeting commercial refrigeration systems pose operational and financial risks to food retailers through inventory spoilage and supply chain disruption.

impacts.name: European Grocery Retail
impacts.why: System disruptions and temperature spikes risk causing inventory losses and operational downtime across supermarket chains.
